jobs.title: Device - Software Engineer (Functional Safety)
jobs.description_text: OUR MISSION SPAN develops products that accelerate the rapid adoption of renewable energy in the home. The flagship SPAN Smart Panel is the first true evolution for the traditional home electric panel, harnessing enhanced technology for metering, monitoring, and control. An expanded product suite of intelligent, integrated solutions radically lowers the cost and complexity of energy upgrades–including solar, batteries and EVs–empowering homeowners to be active, resilient and informed players in the energy market. THE TEAM AND ROLE SPAN's Device Software team is responsible for all of the software that is physically embodied in our hardware products. The Gen3 SPAN Panel is a distributed system of STM32H5 (Arm Cortex-M33) microcontroller modules that talk over CAN, meter power in real time, and open or close relays that sit directly between the grid, the home and its solar, battery and EV equipment. When that firmware makes a decision, real current moves. We are building a dedicated Functional Safety (FuSa) firmware capability to take Gen3 firmware through certification as a Power Control System under UL 3141 and as Class B control software under UL/IEC 60730-1 Annex H. This is not a checkbox exercise: FuSa at SPAN spans how we architect and partition the firmware, how we detect faults and drive the system into defined safe states, how we test and prove coverage, and how we document and trace every safety requirement back to code. jobs.title: Staff Product Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Product Operations exists to give product teams the systems, data, and processes they need to plan, prioritize, and deliver well — the same way Sales Ops supports Sales or DevOps supports Engineering. This role sits at the center of that discipline, contributing to three core areas: the reporting and analytics that give everyone visibility into what's happening, the process that makes planning and delivery repeatable instead of reinvented pod by pod, and the ongoing work of keeping strategy and execution connected as priorities shift. We run Product Operations as a hybrid centralized/embedded model: some Product Ops work sits centrally and serves every product team consistently, while other Product Ops work sits embedded inside individual product lines, close to their day-to-day priorities. This role sits in the centralized hub — you're the shared systems, process, and reporting engine that every embedded product manager and product ops partner relies on, rather than being dedicated to any single product line. The market is concentrated: roughly 225 utilities matter, and the top 75 serve about 85% of U.S. meters. The biggest investor-owned utilities in the country run Skydio X10 fleets and Dock networks for transmission, distribution, and substation inspection, storm response, and asset health. Our largest programs are now five-year, multi-dozen-dock agreements. The market is moving from crews flying handheld drones to autonomous inspection that covers an entire service territory, and this team is leading that shift with tremendous whitespace to drive growth for many years. About the role As Sales Director, Utilities, you will lead five quota-carrying sellers: three Strategic Account Managers on the largest utilities and two Enterprise Account Executives on the next tier. Each seller is paired with a dedicated Solutions Engineer. This team carries the largest number in Commercial Sales, and the plan is to grow it substantially on the same headcount before scaling the team further. This is a land-and-expand business built on deep relationships with a small set of named accounts, not a coverage play. A 100-dock deal takes the same work as a 10-dock deal, and your job is to make the team great at the 100+-dock version. Your number is your team's number. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Real-Time Generalist
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Most full stack roles ask you to move pixels around a dashboard. This one asks you to help architect the system that controls the largest drone swarm on the planet. You’ll join the team building Legion, Swarm Aero’s Command & Control platform. Legion enables a single operator to plan, direct, and execute missions across a networked swarm of heterogeneous aircraft in real time, over intermittent communications, and at a scale nobody else in the industry is attempting. This is not a role maintaining a finished product or adding features around the edges. You’ll help define the architecture, establish core technical patterns, and build entirely new capabilities for a problem space with little prior art. The work spans real-time distributed systems, dense telemetry visualization, collaborative mission planning, and operator interfaces where clarity and reliability directly affect mission outcomes. You’ll have meaningful influence over what we build, how we build it, and how the platform evolves as the team and system scale. jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description_text: The Role Accounting at a company like ours is not a steady-state job. We buy parts, build aircraft, and sign contracts with the government, often all in the same month. Every one of those activities has to be recorded correctly, supportable under audit, and structured so it still holds up when we're ten times bigger. We're looking for an accountant who wants to own that. You'll run the close, keep the ledger clean, and be the person who figures out the right treatment when something new shows up, which will happen often. You'll help set up the cost structures, controls, and processes the company will run on for years. This is a senior role, and we care more about how you think than how long you've been doing it. You'll work closely with finance leadership and partner with operations, supply chain, and our program teams.
